how_to_get_sections.title: Use Cut on Wooden Objects
paragraphs: Using Cut on wooden objects like trees and stumps will produce sturdy sticks. These objects can drop other items as well so be sure to keep an eye out for the sticks.

Trees produce a lot of useful items and are needed for certain habitats, so be sure to keep replanting seeds . This will prevent you from running out of trees, just keep in mind that they take some time to grow.
Seeds drop from trees after cutting them down so don't forget to pick them up. Some Pokemon may also give you seeds as a gift after befriending them.

how_to_use_sections.title: Used for Crafting

how_to_use_sections.title: Power Up Furnaces
paragraphs: Sturdy sticks can also be placed inside a furnace to power it up. Furnaces serve as generators that provide power to other structures such as streetlights and vending machines.
This is especially useful for the Brighten Things Up request in Bleak Beach .

how_to_get_sections.title: Befriend Scyther
paragraphs: Lumber is obtained by processing small logs with Scyther's (or any Pokemon with a Chop specialty) help.

With that said, the first step to getting lumber in the early game is befriending Scyther . They will appear on Tree-shaded tall grass , which is a habitat made by growing 4 tiles of tall grass next to a large tree.

how_to_get_sections.title: Gather Small Logs
paragraphs: Soon after befriending Scyther, they will ask for 2 sturdy sticks through a request that will unlock the Move Cut . This Move allows you to shred wooden objects, like trees and log piles, to obtain small logs . These small logs are the raw materials required to get lumber.
Aside from logs, trees can also drop seeds when you cut them down. Be sure to plant these seeds and tend to them so that you have a steady supply of logs and lumber.
Some Pokemon can also give you seeds as a gift after befriending them.

how_to_get_sections.title: Process Small Logs Into Lumber
paragraphs: Bring the small logs that you've collected to Scyther , and they will start processing them into lumber! The process takes some time, so you'll need to return later to collect the finished product.
Later on in the game, you can obtain lumber by giving small logs to any Pokemon with the Chop specialty .

how_to_get_sections.title: Melt Pokemetal Fragments in Smelting Furnace
paragraphs: Pokemetal may be obtained by processing a Pokemetal fragments into a smelting furnace with the help of a Pokemon with the Burn Specialty. It takes some time to process, so try to stock up and keep your Pokemon friends busy!
Pokemetal fragments are obtained by breaking Pokemetal Blocks using the enhanced Rock Smash .
The recipe for Smelting Furnace may be obtained by meeting Magmar during the Rocky Ridge main story .

You can find Pokemetal Blocks to get Pokemetal fragments from in the Withered Wasteland mine. The mine entrance is located north of the island , and it is blocked by a gate fence that can be removed using enhanced Cut .
To find the Pokemetal inside, proceed down the steps after entering, then immediately turn left at the fork and follow the railway track .

Pokemetal Blocks can also be found in Sparkling Skylands, on the floating island to the east . To reach the area, you'll need to learn how to transform into a Dragonite first by progressing through the main story.
If you are visiting the east island for the first time, you will encounter Gardevoir, who will direct you to the Pokemetal location.
You can also find Pokemetal Block to farm Pokemetal fragments by visiting Sky Dream Island. You can get there by giving Drifloon a Dragonite doll , which you may do once every day.
